comparisons.peer_topic: Redemption of Series K and Series P Preferred Stock in 2024
comparisons.peer_summary: In 2024, the firm redeemed all outstanding shares of its Series K Preferred Stock ($700 million value) and Series P Preferred Stock ($1.50 billion value), recording a $34 million difference between redemption value and net carrying value as an addition to preferred stock dividends.
comparisons.comparison: Both disclosures address the redemption of preferred stock series in 2024. While GS redeemed Series K and Series P, and C redeemed Series U, both entities report the redemption event and the accounting treatment involving the difference between redemption value and carrying value recorded as an addition to preferred stock dividends (GS reports a $34 million addition; C's context implies redemption is the driver for the 'not applicable' status, consistent with redemption accounting).

In 2024, the firm redeemed all outstanding shares of its (i) Series K 6.375% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Non-Cumulative Preferred Stock (Series K Preferred Stock) with a redemption value of $700 million ($25,000 per share), plus accrued and unpaid dividends and (ii) Series P 5.00% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Non-Cumulative Preferred Stock (Series P Preferred Stock) with a redemption value of $1.50 billion ($25,000 per share), plus accrued and unpaid dividends.
The difference between the redemption value and net carrying value at the time of these redemptions was $34 million, which was recorded as an addition to preferred stock dividends in 2024.
